title.narrative: Protecting and Defending Freedom of Expression and Data Privacy on Digital World in Turkey
Protecting and Defending Freedom of Expression and Data Privacy on Digital World in Turkey

description.narrative: The project aimed to monitor violations of digital privacy rights, publish reports, and undertake strategic legal actions, led by MLSA’s Free Web Turkey platform, while also providing civil society organizations, media, and the public with knowledge and tools to navigate the challenges and opportunities of artificial intelligence
